# installed toolchain (TID): development slice backlog

## purpose

The trackable **`TID-###`** slice index for the installed `sv0` / `sv0c` /
`sv0vm` program. Each slice is one focused session with one stopping point
(the **done when** column). Strategy, gaps (`G-*`), cross-spec conflicts
(`X-*`), and decisions (`D-*`) live in the hub
**`task/sv0-toolchain-interface-distribution.Rmd`**. The contract is
`~/Documents/project-specs/sv0-toolchain-interface-and-distribution/SPEC.md`
`0.1.1-draft`. Flip status and record a one-line result + commit as slices land.

## how to use

- Bands: `0xx` = F0 (SPEC Phases A–B), `1xx` = R0 `sv0c` (Phase C), `2xx` =
  R0 `sv0` (Phase D), `3xx` = R0 `sv0vm` (Phase E), `4xx` = BR1 (Phase F),
  `9xx` = post-BR1.
- Status: **todo** / **wip** / **done** / **blocked (D-n / X-n)** / **deferred**.
  A `red` slice is fixtures or tests that must fail for the intended reason
  before its implementation slice (SPEC §27.1 exit criterion).
- Repo column: `c` = sv0c, `vm` = sv0vm, `doc` = sv0doc, `root` = sv0-toolchain.
- `1xx`–`4xx` rows are deliberately coarser. Re-slice each band when its
  predecessor gate closes.

## progress dashboard (sv0-track)

<!-- sv0-track:begin {"id":"tid.checklist.session","title":"TID slice checklist — session hooks","kind":"checklist-region","ingest":"gfm","milestone":"TID"} -->
- [ ] Slice status flipped + one-line result (commit) recorded when a `TID-###` lands
- [ ] `red` slices fail for the intended reason before the paired implementation slice
- [ ] Commit cites the SPEC requirement IDs and `AC-*` scenarios the slice closes
- [ ] Old-CLI tests touched by a slice are re-labeled as migration tests, not deleted (SPEC §27.1 step 5)
- [ ] `./scripts/sv0 test-guards` after editing this file
<!-- sv0-track:end {"id":"tid.checklist.session"} -->
